about: Tests that are known to be red and must not turn a run red. A matching failure is listed in the summary under 'Known issues' and does not count; a crash, an ensure or a timeout still does.
test      the full test path; * and ? wildcards are allowed (fnmatch, case-sensitive), e.g. "DreamGUI.UMGParity.EveryUMGMemberHasSomewhereToGo.*"
reason    why it is red, in a sentence: the behaviour that is wrong, not the assertion text
decision  where it was decided to live with it: a decision record, an issue, a commit
added     the date it was entered, yyyy-mm-dd
presets   optional: only in these presets (e.g. ["Rhi"]); absent means every preset
When a listed test passes, the summary says so: take the entry out, so that the next regression is red again.
